mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submissions ( problem_id, user_id, language, source_code, status ) VALUES ( #{problemId}, #{userId}, #{language}, #{sourceCode}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id, problem_id, user_id, language, source_code, status, verdict, exec_time_ms, memory_kb, error_message, submitted_at, judged_at FROM submissions WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET status = #{status}, verdict = #{verdict}, exec_time_ms = #{execTimeMs}, memory_kb = #{memoryKb}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, judged_at = #{judgedAt} WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.submission_id, s.problem_id, cp.title AS problem_title, s.language, s.verdict, s.exec_time_ms, s.submitted_at FROM submissions s LEFT JOIN coding_problems cp ON s.problem_id = cp.problem_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET status = 'FAILED', verdict = NULL, error_message = #{errorMessage}, judged_at = NOW() WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSubmissions, SUM(verdict = 'AC') AS acCount, COUNT(DISTINCT problem_id) AS attemptedProblems, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN verdict = 'AC' THEN problem_id END) AS solvedProblems FROM submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
